screen.summary: Browser-only auth callback fragment handler. Parses URL hash (access_token/refresh_token/error_code), calls Supabase Auth setSession, then router.replace to sanitized next or /auth/error?reason=<canonical>. No public-schema DB read/write.

rows.screenRequirement: access_token fragment value (read from window.location.hash, passed to supabase.auth.setSession)
rows.docSource: description.md L35 '#access_token과 #refresh_token이 모두 있으면 ... auth.setSession을 호출한다'; functional-spec.md L47 데이터 사용표 'Supabase Auth:setSession | access_token, refresh_token | auth action'; screen-data-summary.md L31 확정계약 'DB 계약 없음 ... public schema에 저장하지 않는다'
rows.rationale: Transient Supabase Auth credential consumed entirely client-side by auth.setSession. Doc 확정 계약 explicitly states it is NOT stored in public schema and the URL fragment is removed after processing. No public-schema column is needed or wanted; the Supabase Auth (auth.users / GoTrue) flow owns it. Correctly satisfied without a public.* object.

rows.screenRequirement: refresh_token fragment value (read from hash, passed to setSession)
rows.docSource: description.md L35; functional-spec.md L47; screen-data-summary.md L31 'access/refresh token 처리는 Supabase Auth setSession 흐름이며 public schema에 저장하지 않는다'
rows.rationale: Same as access_token: transient GoTrue credential, never persisted to public schema by design (확정 계약). Establishing the session afterward causes downstream screens to read profiles/etc. under RLS, but X-17 itself writes nothing. No public.* object required.

rows.screenRequirement: error_code fragment (mapped via mapSupabaseErrorCode to a canonical reason, then routed to /auth/error?reason=<canonical>)
rows.docSource: description.md L34 '#error_code가 있으면 mapSupabaseErrorCode로 canonical reason에 매핑해 X-11 /auth/error?reason=...로 이동'; functional-spec.md L27 '`error_code` canonical reason 매핑'
rows.rationale: error_code is a transient hash value mapped by a pure code-level function (mapSupabaseErrorCode in src/lib/auth/error-mapping.ts). It is never queried, validated, or rendered against DB rows; it is converted to a URL reason param. No public-schema object involved. Raw provider error is explicitly NOT exposed to UI/URL (description.md L37, functional-spec.md L36).

rows.screenRequirement: next redirect target (server-sanitized relative URL via sanitizeNext, default /dashboard; used by router.replace)
rows.docSource: description.md L36 '`next`는 page 진입 시 server에서 `sanitizeNext`를 통과한 relative URL만 component로 전달(기본값 /dashboard)'; functional-spec.md L28 '`next` relative URL sanitization'; L37 'open redirect가 되지 않도록 ... sanitizeNext를 통과'
rows.rationale: Pure URL/routing value sanitized by sanitizeNext (code-level, open-redirect guard). Not data persisted or read from any table. No public-schema object needed.

rows.screenRequirement: error reason / canonical reason text shown via X-11 redirect; status copy ('인증을 확인 중이에요…', '이동 중이에요…')
rows.docSource: description.md L60-62 피드백; screen-data-summary.md L32 'callback 오류 문구 | 스키마 보강 필요 | callback reason별 문구와 redirect 정책을 운영 데이터로 관리하는 구조는 없다 | 현재는 앱 라우팅 계약이다'; L45 스키마 정합성 메모 '오류 문구와 redirect 정책 운영화는 스키마 보강 필요'
rows.rationale: CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL applied: the row is LABELED '스키마 보강 필요', but its 확정 계약 + 메모 state the reason copy / redirect policy is currently an APP-ROUTING CONTRACT (mapSupabaseErrorCode + static status strings), with no operational-data structure existing or required now. description.md confirms no DB query/validation/render need — copy is in-app static text routed to X-11. So accept current handling (no DB-backed copy table) with stableQueryNeed=false; do NOT invent a column. No jsonb blob is literally used either, but per the rule this non-DB-need item is treated as covered-without-schema-change (not a real gap). Future operationalization of reason copy is a deferred 추가 발견 후보, not a current screen requirement.

rows.screenRequirement: callback fragment failure-rate observability (server-visible correlation id or client telemetry)
rows.docSource: screen-data-summary.md (추가 발견 후보 via functional-spec.md L71 'callback fragment 실패율을 운영에서 보려면 server-visible correlation id 또는 client telemetry가 별도 필요하다')
rows.rationale: Explicitly flagged in docs as a separate future need ('별도 필요'), NOT a confirmed requirement of the current X-17 screen. study_events exists but its event_type catalog is frozen separately and contains no auth-callback/telemetry event; adding an auth-failure telemetry sink would be net-new operational scope. Route to UNRESOLVED / escalate per scope rules; do not apply. setSession failure is currently console.error-only (description.md L44, L68), not persisted.

jsonMappingNote: No seed JSON exists for X-17 (confirmed: folder contains only description.md, functional-spec.md, screen-data-summary.md; no *.json sample). X-17 persists nothing to public schema, so there is no key→column mapping and no seed provenance to preserve. JSON MAPPING RULE is N/A for this screen.

deferredEscalations: callback fragment failure-rate observability (correlation id / client telemetry) — net-new operational scope, study_events event_type catalog frozen; escalate, do not apply.
operationalizing callback reason copy + redirect policy as data — labeled 스키마 보강 필요 but 확정 계약 keeps it as app-routing contract; deferred, no current screen need.
summaryFindings.verdict: X-17 is an Auth-only transient-fragment handler with ZERO public-schema data contract. All four runtime values (access_token, refresh_token, error_code, next) are transient and handled by Supabase Auth setSession + code-level sanitize/map functions. No additive migration is warranted; no column should be invented. Two items are correctly deferred/escalated (observability, reason-copy operationalization).
